content.text: Section 18 meets the preferred position in full. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 already contains a Vendor-side insurance covenant matching or exceeding our preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law (plus employer's liability USD 1M), professional E&O of USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M, maintained at Vendor's expense throughout the term and for one year afterward. Section 18.2 gives us certificates and evidence of coverage on request, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, primary coverage where customary, and expressly confirms that "Insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities," so the Section 21 liability cap does not erode these coverages. No redline needed.
